resources.string: Bonds this phone\'s WiFi and mobile data across your own concentrator.
the hex key the installer printed
Turn on this phone\'s hotspot, connect another device to it, and point that device\'s proxy client (Surge, for example) at the address above. Its traffic then goes out over the bond.

Devices on this phone\'s hotspot are not bonded automatically: Android forwards tethered traffic in the kernel, outside the VPN. Sending them through the proxy above is what puts them on the bond. The proxy carries TCP; other traffic still goes out unbonded.
